name: search
description: One search over everything a person has: every record of every content type and every block on the canvas. A form with one field and one button, because that is the better thing here; it is a GET, so a search is a link that can be kept. Its results can be narrowed to one kind, counted from the same search, with everything one link away.

use.when: the person wants to find something by the words in it, from wherever they are; it belongs in the header, where they reach for it on every page.
use.not: filtering one list, which is the listing page, or asking the assistant, which is the chat.
use.with: header at compact or icon size once the person knows it is there.

empty.description: When there are no matching results (search empty: nothing found), show an h2 heading and suggest trying different words.
empty.text: Nothing matches “X”. Try different words, or ask the assistant.

label.description: The visible label and the button text.

value.description: Words already typed, when showing results for them.

action.description: Where the search goes; the search page by default.

id.description: Id of the field, so the label reaches it.

type.description: Narrow the results to one kind, such as task, when the box belongs to that kind's place; the results page says so first and links to everything. Name the kind in the label too, Search tasks, so the scope is said at the box. Leave empty anywhere general.

a11y.role: search (a landmark) holding a labelled search field and a submit button; on the results page the kinds are a navigation of links with counts, the one shown marked aria-current=page

keyboard.does: moves to the field, then the button

wcag.notes: A visible label (3.3.2), a search landmark (1.3.1, 2.4.1), and a real form so it works without a script. The field is type=search, so assistive technology says what it is. A narrowed search says its kind in the label, the heading and the window title, so it is heard as the page arrives (2.4.2); no live region, because the results are a new page.

machine.identify: A form with role=search. The field is named q; a hidden field named type, when there, narrows the results to that kind; the action is where results appear.
machine.operate: Type words into the field named q and submit, or GET the action with ?q=words, adding &type=task to narrow to tasks; the same results are at /api/search?q=words&type=task. A type that is not a kind a person has is refused with 400.
